description.narrative: The objective of Social Assistance Modernization Project for Albania it to support country's implementation of reforms to improve the equity and efficiency of its social assistance programs. The project has two components. (1) Strengthening the implementation and performance of social assistance programs. The objective of this component is to support the results of implementation of improvements in the main social assistance programs. The component will support improved implementation of both the Ndihma Ekonomike (NE) program and disability assistance benefits in the main areas identified in the broad. Roadmap for reforms: (a) program parameters (eligibility criteria and intake processes); (b) benefits administration (business processes, management of information, and payments mechanisms, and reporting and monitoring); and (c) oversight and controls. (2) Technical assistance to strengthen implementation capacity for social assistance programs. The objectives of this component are to strengthen capacity for implementing improvements in the delivery of social assistance benefits. This component will finance select technical assistance and investment activities.
The project would support the Albania's implementation of reforms to improve the equity and efficiency of its social assistance programs.

condition.narrative: Completion of DA program in the Tirana Region by December 31, 2019.
Establishment of an inter-ministerial Coordination Working Group for decision making on implementation of reforms in socialassistance programs.

Finance Agreement: Appropriate budget allocations | Description: The Borrower shall ensure that, throughout the period of Projectimplementation, appropriate budget allocations' are made available yearly for Project implementation purposes. | Frequency: Yearly

Finance Agreement: Hire additional staff for MOLSA | Description: Within three (3) month from the effectiveness, the Borrower shallhave additional staff in the Department of Social Services Policy of MOLSA, with TOR acceptable to the Bank and with the projectmanagement, monitoring and evaluation expertise, and maintain thorough the project implementation period. | Due Date: 31-Jan-2013

Finance Agreement: Maintain the Project's Coordination Working Group | Description: Maintain, throughout the period of Projectimplementation, the Coordination Working Group, chaired by the Deputy Minister of MOLSA and including representatives from MOLSA,State Social Services and National Agency for Information Society, which is responsible for leading implementation of reforms insocial assistance programs and ensuring coordination of activities. | Frequency: Yearly

title.narrative: Percentage of households in the poorest 10% that are covered by the Ndihma Ekonomike (NE) Program.
Percentage of NE benefits received by the poorest 10% households.
Percentage of households receiving benefits for the NE program that have been screened for eligibility using the Unified Scoring Formula agreed with the World Bank
Percentage of social administrators trained in implementation of the Unified Scoring Formula
Percentage of suspected fraud and error cases in the DA program that are investigated by social inspectors in accordance with revised sanctions policy and legislation
Percentage of NE applicants case files that are complete and consistent with the USF application and intake processes
Share of disability assistance beneficiaries that report no functional disability
Adoption of Social Model for DA eligibility assessment

baseline.value: DA assessment based on medical model

target.value: Assessment criteria, business procedures and institutional arrangements for the DA program are revised based on the Social Model, and these revisions are consulted, approved and disseminated (DLI 6)

actual.value: Assessment criteria, business procedures and institutional arrangements for the DAP are revised based on the Social Model, and these revisions are consulted, approved and disseminated.

title.narrative: MHSP has access to real-time data on DA applicants and beneficiaries in pilot areas

target.value: DA MIS developed and operational in Tirana, Elbasan and Durres regions

actual.value: DA MIS developed and operational in all three regions

title.narrative: The average time (days) needed to determine eligibility status of applicants
Grievances registered related to delivery of DA benefits that are actually addressed
Percentage of local government units that use the automated MIS to process DA applicants registration, beneficiary selection, program enrollment, and payment orders

comment.narrative: <p>The original target was set nationwide, while the revised target was set for Tirana, Elbasan, and Durres regions only. </p>

title.narrative: Number of SSS Regional Offices rehabilitated
Share of DA beneficiaries in the three pilot regions satisfied with the access, quality of facilities, quality of services, and responsiveness to needs
Percentage of new DA applications and recertification requests in Tirana, Elbasan and Durres that have been reassessed using revised criteria and processes based on the Social Model
Percentage of new applications and recertification requests received in Tirana, Elbasan and Durres that have been processed using the automated DA MIS
Average number of weekly visits by PWD
Strategy and action plan developed to guide the NE exit

baseline.value: No strategy and no action plan in place

actual.value: Strategy and action plan developed, consulted, approved by COM, and disseminated
